plain: Lack of feeling or interest in what is going on.

webster.text: Want of feeling; an utter privation of passion, or insensibility to pain; applied either to the body or the mind.

example.quote: And thus it is, that the more the injuries and insults of Britain thicken upon us, the greater the apathy and silence respecting them.
example.cite: James Madison, Foreign Influence, Aurora General Advertiser, Jan. 23, 1799
